name: Intraday time-series momentum — signed continuation with RSI-strength confirm (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same intraday time-series momentum lead-lag (early-window sign predicts close-window sign via late-informed flow + end-of-window hedging) but the trend-not-chop gate is an RSI strength band (rsi above a mid-line floor = sustained buying pressure without full exhaustion) rather than adx. This isolates whether the continuation needs a directional-STRENGTH confirmation vs a raw trend-STRUCTURE (adx) confirmation — economically distinct filters on the same lead-lag signal. Entry: positive signed trailing ret_Nd AND rsi above a fitted floor (momentum with fuel left). DISCONFIRMER: kill if it wins when rsi is instead used as an OVERBOUGHT ceiling (fade) — that would mean rsi is acting as reversion, not continuation. Kill if net edge < 3x round-trip taker cost, or if the lead-lag has no monotonic OOS relationship in a purged split.
catalyst: early-session momentum with sustained buying pressure into the close
